title: Northgate Optical Lab Blank Costs: Refundable Material Amount
content:
For a Northgate Optical job cancelled in the lab, the refundable material amount depends on the lens material of the job.

**Clause.** Where the material is polycarbonate or Trivex, the lab keeps the cost of a standard impact blank, so the refundable material amount is the net material upgrade charge less the polycarbonate upgrade price of the job's lens design, never less than zero; where the material is a 1.60, 1.67 or 1.74 high index material, the refundable material amount is half of the net material upgrade charge (50 percent). Each applies where a material upgrade charge was posted on the job. Standard plastic is subject to neither term.

**The net material upgrade charge** is the material upgrade charge of the original order less every credit already posted against material upgrade charges of the job.

**Polycarbonate upgrade price of the job's lens design:**

| Lens design | Polycarbonate upgrade price |
|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 25.00 |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 25.00 |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 25.00 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 30.00 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 30.00 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 30.00 |

## Applications (hypothetical jobs)

| Job | Net material upgrade charge | Term | Refundable material amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses, Trivex | 45.00 | less 30.00 | 15.00 |
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses, Trivex | 40.00 | less 25.00 | 15.00 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses, polycarbonate | 30.00 | less 30.00 | 0.00 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses, polycarbonate after a Plus discount | 25.50 | less 30.00, never below zero | 0.00 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses, 1.67 high index | 70.00 | half | 35.00 |
